id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|450f: "He was always serious and quiet, but speaks even less now. I can't tell what he's thinking.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4521: "With the Dark One defeated, the murk in the sky has cleared and fish are returning to the sea.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|452a: "The refreshing wind the tree released as it rose to the sky must have been a healing wind.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|453f: "I taught my son Kinai since childhood to have the strength to protect the weak.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|454b: "When I heard he served as a decoy so the village fishermen could escape the merfolk, I wasn't surprised at all.
id./param/region/r005.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4558: "And he's not so unfilial as to leave his mother behind and go to the other world. I believe he'll surely return.

tm.「あの浜から見える海は とても さびしいが\n 父が描く 絵の中の海は\n なぜ: "The sea seen from that beach is lonely, but somehow the sea in Father's paintings was so beautiful...
tm.「何があったかは わからんが\n キナイは あんたを信頼してるようじゃ。: "I don't know what happened, but Kinai seems to trust you.
tm.「幼い頃から 気むずかしい子じゃったから\n こんなことは はじめてじゃ。\n: "He's been difficult since childhood, so this is a first. Please be kind to him.
tm.「キナイの様子が 近頃 おかしいのじゃ。\n 以前は 近寄りもしなかった しじま: "Kinai has been acting strange lately. He's been spending all his time at Silent Shore, which he used to avoid.
tm.「あそこにある 小さな小屋は\n 私の父が 長年 使っていた場所でね。\n 息子: "The small hut there was where my father worked for many years. My son hated that place...
tm.「命の大樹が 地に落ちてからというもの\n 海も空も 怪しげな色に染まり\n 魚: "Ever since Yggdrasil fell, sea and sky are dyed strange colors, no fish are caught, and everyone's spirits are low.
tm.「大樹から 遠く離れた この村でさえ\n このようなありさま……。\n 世界は: "Even this village far from the tree is in this state... What is happening to the world...
tm.「旅人さん 遠路はるばる ご苦労さまです。\n ……もしや息子に ご用ですかな？: "Traveler, thank you for coming so far. ...Do you need my son? He's surely at Silent Shore.
tm.「旅人さんが クラーゴンを倒した あの夜から\n 息子は なにやら様子が おかし: "Since the night you defeated the Kraken, my son has acted strange, spending all his time at Silent Shore.
tm.「もともと マジメで寡黙な子じゃったが\n 以前にも増して 口数がへって\n 何: "He was always serious and quiet, but speaks even less now. I can't tell what he's thinking.
tm.「魔王が倒された おかげで\n 空のよどみが晴れ 海に魚が戻りはじめた。: "With the Dark One defeated, the murk in the sky has cleared and fish are returning to the sea.
tm.「命の大樹が 空にのぼっていく時に\n 大樹が放った すがすがしい風は\n きっ: "The refreshing wind the tree released as it rose to the sky must have been a healing wind.
tm.「息子のキナイには 幼い頃から\n 弱い者を守れる強さを 持つのじゃと\n 言い: "I taught my son Kinai since childhood to have the strength to protect the weak.
tm.「マーマンの群れから 村の漁師たちを逃がすため\n あの子が オトリになったと聞: "When I heard he served as a decoy so the village fishermen could escape the merfolk, I wasn't surprised at all.
tm.「それに あの子は 母を残して\n あの世に行くような 親不孝な息子じゃない。\: "And he's not so unfilial as to leave his mother behind and go to the other world. I believe he'll surely return.
